attBesluta.text: Livrée très rapidement sous deux jours. Conforme et en bon état.

If you are looking to get your quad muscles in shape, purchase this unit. Supersizing very light weight, but it supports over 300lbs /136kg. Easy to assemble, quality parts/paint. Once assembled, I would use better tools (sockets) to tighten all the bolts. Check the tightness every month. Just to be safe. I am recovering from a quad tendon injury. This machine is helping with my recovery. I will use this machine daily even when I am fully recovered. Five minutes a day to do 3 sets of 10 squats will strengthen quad, core muscles, hamstrings, calves, and probably more. If you do this, I am sure withing a month you will notice climbing stairs will much easily.

I am really enjoying this exercise equipment. I do about 20 of these. A couple times a day. I’m going to work my way up and get in better shape, but I’m 66 years old and after two weeks, I can stand up without pushing on the armrest of the chair. I do enjoy using it thank you.

Czas realizacji zgodnie z wskazanym terminie a nawet szybciej o dwa dni. Sama przesyłka zgodna z opisem, wykonanie super, montaż dziecinnie prosty, wszystkie elementy opisane i solidne. Polecam firmę, na pewno jeszcze coś kupię choć to był mój zakup. Ocena na pięć gwiazdek daję pięć z plusem.

Nu poate fi asamblat din cauza lipsei unui surub esential nr.18 di schema si binenteles saiba si piulita. Bani risipiti, dezamagire ca si la alte produse care au necesitat asamblare dar au avut lipsa cate ceva dupa care stai sa astepti pana vine. Astept urgent aceste mici piese, acum dupa ce l-am asamblat in proportie de 99%.

I've been looking for an affordable gym sled for a while now. Vevors sled is robust, easy to assemble and looks good. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to take there training to new levels. 10/10.
Excelente producto. Precio calidad. Fácil armado y muy practico.

The sled is well manufactured tired. It held up well with 400lbs on concrete and in grass. Great workout for the legs and cross training. I’ve used it more than a dozen times and it’s holding up very well.
It is easy to assemble and use.It is cheap and gets the job done.
Handles are shaped nicely. Well made for the price.

I've been using my sled now for about 1 month. I wasn't crazy about the pulling harness it came with, so I bought another one. Turns out it's a much heavier harness which I like, but it buckles right at the bottom of my ribcage. So I'm back to the original harness. It works OK, but I have it adjusted all the way out, and it's still snug. The sled on the othe hand has been great. I've pulled it through water, mud, tall grass and mulch, it works greatand has been a great workout. I did add a stop collar to help quite the weights as they tend to rattle while being pulled. The 2" stopped collar helped a lot.

Hi, I bought two pieces. They arrived extremely quickly. The product is very nice and as described. The only downside is that the vinyl is very thin. After half an hour of use on a chair, it cracked at the seat. The customer service guys were impeccable. They replaced the product in 5-6 days. I'm very thankful for that. I hope it doesn't crack again. Vali

I am pleasantly surprised at how quickly I received the boat seat. It arrived in just a couple of days. When I opened it up, it was bubble wrapped inside it's container and it also came with new stainless screws. It was so easy to attach to the base and I didn't have to purchase any extra hardware. Nice to get something that I didn't have to buy more stuff to put it together.
